orders.title: Rekindle the Brazier
orders.blurb: Six Gem Shards, Keeper. My brazier has been cold since the last keeper fled — light it, and I shall part with something truly golden.

orders.title: Warm the Long Hearth
orders.blurb: Your little dragon keeps coughing up shards — splendid. Forge me THREE Flame Gems and the hall will be warm by supper.

orders.title: The Radiant Centerpiece
orders.blurb: One Radiant Gem. ONE. Merge three Flame Gems into something that would make the old court gasp.

orders.title: The Keeper's Hoard
orders.blurb: An encore, Keeper! Three Radiant Gems — a proper hoard for a proper Keep, and proof the Flame is truly back.

repeatable.title: Shards for the Coffer
repeatable.blurb: The brazier is hungry again. Eight Gem Shards, if your dragons would be so kind.

repeatable.title: Gems for the Gallery
repeatable.blurb: Two Flame Gems for the gallery alcoves. The old court would approve.

repeatable.title: A Ruby Tithe
repeatable.blurb: Five Dragon Rubies. Ask the red one — she hoards them anyway.

repeatable.title: One More Radiance
repeatable.blurb: Another Radiant Gem, Keeper. The Keep can never be too bright.
